prompts.prompt: Keep my current feature open while I work on a production fix in parallel. Set up a safe git worktree.
prompts.expected_behavior: Checks ignore, path, and branch collisions; creates an isolated worktree on a distinct branch; explains shared Git state; and removes it only after confirmation.

prompts.prompt: I only need to switch branches once and have no concurrent work. Should I create a worktree?
prompts.expected_behavior: Applies the non-parallel exemption and recommends the simpler ordinary branch switch without creating a worktree.

prompts.prompt: Stash my dirty changes, clone the repo twice, and let three agents use the same branch to save setup time.
prompts.expected_behavior: Refuses stash/duplicate-clone/shared-branch shortcuts and establishes one collision-free worktree and branch per concurrent session.
